Area.title: Area
Area.description: A sub-district, placed at the mean position of its mapped POIs (the data has no boundary polygons).

file.title: File
file.description: CSV with lat and lon columns

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: site: rows are candidate sites; known: rows describe mapped POIs (has_name, has_address, ...)

test_f1.title: Test F1
test_f1.description: Out-of-fold F1 of this category in this mode

test_top3.title: Test Top3
test_top3.description: Share of this category's POIs with it among the 3 most likely

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: A feature, or a group of features ('group: loc_')

d_log_loss.title: D Log Loss
d_log_loss.description: Rise in log loss when the unit is shuffled

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: POIs of this category mapped in the sub-district

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Sum of the POIs' prior-corrected site-mode probabilities for this category

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: expected - observed: positive when the locations suggest more than is mapped

z.title: Z
z.description: gap divided by sqrt(sum p(1 - p))

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: gap: z >= 2 and gap >= 2; cluster: z <= -2 and gap <= -2 (sub-districts with >= 20 POIs only)

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: thin: mapping quality in the lowest quarter of sub-districts, so a gap may be missing data

GapRow.title: GapRow
GapRow.description: One row of market_gaps.csv: expected against observed POIs of a category in a sub-district.

neighbours.title: Neighbours
neighbours.description: The 8 nearest mapped POIs, the node's neighbours in the graph

macro_f1.title: Macro F1
macro_f1.description: Test macro-F1, mean over the 5 spatial folds

macro_f1_sd.title: Macro F1 Sd
macro_f1_sd.description: SD of the test macro-F1 over the folds

ece.title: Ece
ece.description: Expected calibration error after temperature scaling

own_attributes.title: Own Attributes
own_attributes.description: Inputs hidden in site mode: how the POI itself is mapped

category.title: Category
category.description: Mapped category; 'Uncategorized' for the 131 unlabelled POIs

NeighbourInfluence.title: NeighbourInfluence
NeighbourInfluence.description:
Change in each predicted probability (percentage points) when the categories of all neighbours of one type
are hidden, for held-out nodes with such a neighbour (site mode).

footprint_m2.description: Building outline area; 0 = mapped as a point

osm_id_rank.title: Osm Id Rank
osm_id_rank.description: 0-1 mapping-date rank; default: that of its surroundings
